responsibility: Defines the lowering visitor for individual enum variants. It converts each AST enum item form—unit, tuple, struct, and discriminant-bearing variants—into the corresponding HIR::EnumItem subclass, lowering field types and optional discriminant expressions, rejecting illegal per-variant visibility, checking duplicate struct-field names where needed, and registering the resulting variant with HIR/DefId/location mappings. This file is specifically about variant members, not whole enum declarations.
